finding: RBM-v0's 2-feature (latency,peak) boolean is a BAND CHECK, not a presence detector: a constant-latency macro (FAR 0.76), replayed reflexes (0.90), random-in-band (0.43) and a Gaussian bot (0.61) all clear it. Latency+peak cannot distinguish a human reflex from a bot that outputs in-band values.
remediation: presence needs (1) force-response CURVE-SHAPE features (a reflex is a biomechanical curve; a macro is a step/pulse) to defeat A-CONST/A-RAND/A-JITTER, AND (2) nonce-bound challenge-response to defeat A-REPLAY (a replayed trace cannot answer a fresh nonce). That is RBM-v1 + the full PoEP challenge stack, not RBM-v0.
verdict: poep_enabled MUST stay False. The adversarial harness is now the permanent gate any future model must clear before P4.
